about.heroSub: We are shaping the future of banking
about.missionText: Finanzkredit was founded with a clear vision: to democratize banking services and make them accessible to everyone. We believe that top-class financial services should not be a matter of wealth.
about.visionText: A world where every person has access to fair, transparent and innovative financial products — regardless of origin or income.

vermoegensVerwaltung.name: Wealth Management
vermoegensVerwaltung.intro: Make your money work for you. Our experienced wealth managers develop an individual investment strategy tailored to your goals and risk appetite.

b1.title: Active Portfolio Management
b1.desc: Continuous monitoring and adjustment of your portfolio.

b2.title: Risk Diversification
b2.desc: Broad spread across asset classes and markets.

b3.title: Personal Advisor
b3.desc: A dedicated expert for all your questions.

b4.title: Transparent Reports
b4.desc: Monthly performance reports in real time.

lebensversicherung.name: Life Insurance
lebensversicherung.intro: Protect your family and loved ones. Our flexible life insurance policies offer comprehensive coverage and can be combined with a savings component.

b1.title: Survivor Protection
b1.desc: Financial security for your family in the event of a claim.

b2.title: Endowment Insurance
b2.desc: Combination of protection and wealth building.

b3.title: Flexible Terms
b3.desc: From 10 to 40 years — tailored to your needs.

b4.title: Tax Advantages
b4.desc: Benefits can be paid out tax-free.

trading.name: Trading & Stock Market
trading.intro: Trade stocks, ETFs, funds and more via our modern trading platform. Benefit from low fees, real-time data and professional analysis tools.

b1.title: Real-Time Prices
b1.desc: Live data from over 60 global stock exchanges.

b2.title: Free Depot
b2.desc: No base fees, fair transaction costs.

studentenkredit.name: Student Loan
studentenkredit.intro: Focus on your studies while we handle your finances. Our student loan offers favourable terms with flexible repayment after graduation.

b1.title: Up to €50,000
b1.desc: For tuition fees, living costs and more.

b2.title: Repayment after graduation
b2.desc: Deferred repayment up to 12 months after graduation.

geschaeftskredit.name: Business Loan
geschaeftskredit.intro: Grow with the right capital behind you. Whether investment, working capital or expansion — our business loan offers tailored financing for companies of any size.

b1.title: Up to €2,000,000
b1.desc: For investments, expansion and working capital.

b4.title: Business Advisor
b4.desc: Personal support from corporate client experts.

konsumentenkredit.name: Consumer Credit
konsumentenkredit.intro: Fulfil your wishes — whether travel, renovation or new electronics. Our consumer credit is straightforward, quickly available and fully applicable online.

b1.title: Up to €75,000
b1.desc: For all your personal projects and wishes.

b2.title: Instant Payout
b2.desc: Money in your account within 24 hours.

b3.title: No collateral required
b3.desc: Unsecured loan without property or vehicle pledge.

b4.title: Free early repayment
b4.desc: Flexibly repay extra at any time.

hypothek.name: Mortgage
hypothek.intro: Make your dream of owning a home a reality. Our mortgages offer attractive rates, individual repayment plans and comprehensive advice from the first idea to key handover.

b1.title: Up to 90% financing
b1.desc: High loan-to-value ratio for your property.

b2.title: Fixed rate up to 30 years
b2.desc: Planning security with long-term fixed rate guarantee.

digitalkredit.name: Digital Credit
digitalkredit.intro: The loan for the digital age. Fully online — from application to payout. No branch, no paperwork, no long wait.

b1.title: 100% Digital
b1.desc: Application, review and payout completely online.

b3.title: VideoIdent
b3.desc: Identity verification by video — conveniently from home.

b4.title: Instant Payment
b4.desc: Payout within just a few hours.

autokredit.name: Car Loan
autokredit.intro: Drive your dream car — with fair financing. Whether new, used or electric vehicle: we offer flexible solutions for every vehicle type and budget.

b1.title: New & used vehicles
b1.desc: Financing for vehicles of any age and type.

b2.title: EV Bonus
b2.desc: More favourable conditions for electric vehicles.

b3.title: Up to €150,000
b3.desc: Even for luxury and premium vehicles.

b4.title: Balloon finance possible
b4.desc: Low instalments with residual value at end of term.

agrarkredit.name: Agricultural Credit
agrarkredit.intro: Finance your agricultural operation with tailored agri-credits. From machinery financing to barn construction to land expansion — we support your investments.

b1.title: Agriculture & Forestry
b1.desc: Specialist solutions for all agricultural businesses.

b2.title: Machinery financing
b2.desc: Tractors, combine harvesters and specialist machines.

b3.title: Land purchase & lease
b3.desc: Financing for land purchase and farm succession.
